title: Project orientation
description: Inspect and complete the durable SpecDev project context.

inspect-context.purpose: Inspect whether .specdev/project_notes/big_picture.md contains usable project context.
inspect-context.instructions: Run `specdev start`, inspect `.specdev/project_notes/big_picture.md`, then submit whether the context is already ready.

collect-context.purpose: Collect the project's purpose, users, stack, architecture, and constraints.
collect-context.instructions: Use the installed `specdev-start` skill to interview the user and update `.specdev/project_notes/big_picture.md`. Submit the updated path and a short summary.

verify-context.purpose: Verify that the project context is now complete.
verify-context.instructions: Run `specdev start` again and submit `ready: true` only when it reports durable project context rather than the blank template.
